items.label: Camtek Q1 FY2026 (05-12-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Q1 2026: revenue $121.7M (slightly ahead of guide), GM 51%,

set.signal: Q1 2026: revenue $121.7M (slightly ahead of guide), GM 51%, op income $31.1M (op margin 25.5% — to return to ~30% in H2), EPS $0.70. ~50% of revenue from AI-RELATED products + ~20% more from other advanced packaging. UNPRECEDENTED start-of-year order intake: ORDERS+FORECAST FROM TWO HBM MANUFACTURERS for 3D metrology and 2D inspection representing >$260M of expected revenue across 2026-2027 (a significant chunk ships already in 2026) — plus incremental business expected from these two and OTHER HPC PLAYERS into 2027. Q2 guide $129-131M; H2 2026 revenue to SURGE >25% above H1 (upside possible on Q4-26/early-27 delivery timing). OSAT advanced-packaging investment wave = key opportunity (CEO: 'As the leading provider in this domain for both 2D inspection and 3D metrology, we expect to be major beneficiary of this trend'). Israel operations unaffected (zero missed shipments); Germany capacity expanding.

items.reason: Leadership is the CEO's claim; attribute it instead of stating it as fact.
items.evidence: As the leading provider in this domain for both 2D inspection and 3D metrology, we expect to be major beneficiary of this trend.

items.label: Camtek Q1 FY2026 (05-12-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Products & TAM: Eagle G5 + Hawk (sub-6-micron bump-height me

set.signal: Products & TAM: Eagle G5 + Hawk (sub-6-micron bump-height metrology, 100nm inspection, high throughput) were 30% of 2025 revenue and expected to DOUBLE in 2026; lead times Eagle ~3mo, Hawk 3-6mo with capacity flexibility for upside. Visual Layer acquisition CLOSED — breakthrough AI detection/metrology/classification being integrated (COO: 'I do believe that we will see the contribution of revenues from these capabilities in the second half of this year', after 'It is too early to talk when we should see it as products and revenues'), plus a planned AI-software product line sellable into the thousands-of-systems installed base; AI features expected to expand 2D share and win NEW process steps INCLUDING FRONT END -> TAM grows ~+$0.5B to OVER $2B in 2027. US chiplet IDM customer (the analyst's description; COO: 'definitely there our share is meaningful'): business expected 'towards the latter part of this year and into 2027'. China: 'in a positive trend' and healthy; the COO agreed with the analyst that 2026 growth is driven mainly outside China; 'only one meaningful player that really competes with us in China'.

items.reason: Restore the COO's hedge on H2 2026 AI revenue; the 'US chiplet IDM' and 'non-China' framing were the analyst's words that the COO confirmed, so attribute them.
items.evidence: I do believe that we will see the contribution of revenues from these capabilities in the second half of this year.
